Source: 90_website_canon_llms_full.txt | Title: Bolaji BALOGOUN · Data Engineer · Data Architect (full content) | Section: Gozem Data Hub: operational apps & analytics platform | Parent context: Bolaji BALOGOUN · Biography > Data Director · GOZEM · Apr 2025 - Jul 2026

Result: Unified analytics, AI, and operational tools into a single platform serving 700+ stakeholders across five countries.
Problem: As Gozem evolved from a startup into a scale-up, the demand for operational applications, automation workflows, analytics products, and AI-powered tools grew rapidly across the organization.

Product and engineering teams remained primarily focused on revenue-generating marketplace initiatives, limiting their capacity to support the growing number of operational use cases. Many requests to the Data team recurred, including ad hoc analyses, data extractions, and operational workflows that required intervention from analysts and engineers.

The Data team also lacked a shared environment for its growing portfolio of tools, applications, analytics assets, and AI services. It had two goals.

1. Give operational teams direct access to data products, analytics, and tools to reduce recurring requests to the Data team.
2. Establish a common platform for the Data team to quickly design, deploy, and govern applications, automation, and AI solutions at scale.
Solution: Architected and led the development of **Gozem Data Hub**, a centralized data and AI workspace for delivering self-service products across the organization.

The platform brought operational applications, analytics tools, AI solutions, automation workflows, and data exploration into one environment with shared standards for authentication, authorization, deployment, and governance.

The Data team used reusable architecture and AI-assisted engineering workflows to deliver production applications for operational teams. These applications moved a large share of analytical and operational requests from manual tickets to self-service tools that business users could operate directly.

Business teams could independently access insights, applications, and AI tools, and the Data team had more time for higher-value initiatives.
Tools: React · FastAPI · AWS EC2 · BigQuery · MongoDB · Nginx · Docker · Google Cloud Storage · Artifact Registry · Python
